scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck && pnpm run typecheck:vercel-api
scripts.typecheck:vercel-api: tsc --noEmit --strict --skipLibCheck --target ES2022 --module ESNext --moduleResolution Bundler --lib ES2022,DOM api/quote-requests.ts
